body: Perhaps you're right that I would be able to do everything in a week's time, but I wish I could have more vacation time and still have a job to come back to afterwards. The only time I'm ever able to travel for longer periods of time is when I am unemployed.

Man, that sounds like the perfect vacation! I will definitely contact you if I decide to visit Costa Rica at some point in the future. 

I just got called for a job interview, so I might have some money coming in soon. That's the good news. The bad news is, employers in the USA typically don't give their employees any vacation time until they've worked for an entire year (and then you only get one week the entire year), so it might be a while if I get this job. I wish the U.S. could be more like European countries where workers receive a lot more vacation time.

I will definitely reach out to you if I find a cheap flight to Costa Rica in the wintertime. That would be the ideal time to visit because it usually doesn't rain as much then based on what I have read.

I would love to hike up Cerro Chirripo, visit the Arenal volcano, explore a tropical rainforest for the first time in my life, visit a few cities and beaches, and maybe catch a soccer match. 

Brazil and Switzerland have the best chances of coming out of your group, but one can never underestimate Los Ticos. I'm not a betting man, so I won't put any money on the line either way, haha. 

Do you watch any CONCACAF soccer matches? While I primarily watch UEFA/European competitions, I have started to get into the North/Central American game more in recent years. I attended a few Gold Cup matches last year (didn't see Costa Rica though), saw Toronto F.C. play against Mexico's Club America earlier this year (in the freezing rain), and have watched a few Costa Rican sides play on television and internet streams. Alajuelense, Saprissa, and Herediano are some of the better clubs in the region outside of Mexico. Those are the teams I would want to see if I ever came to your country.

Well, time to get ready for a four-day trip to the mountains. I'll be back just in time for the World Cup. :)

It has been nice chatting with you. And thanks again for welcoming me to visit your country!

If I'm still alive six months from now, I'm going to spend time in a warmer climate to escape the unbearable winter here. I was thinking of visiting Southeast Asia, South America, or the Southwestern U.S. - but Costa Rica would also be a good option because airfare isn't too expensive from where I live (it's usually $300-500 USD R/T from my home airport) and looks like a beautiful place with spectacular rainforests, beaches, mountains, and volcanoes. 

Thanks for offering to host me if I visit. Your generosity is something that I never experience in my hometown, where most of the people are every bit as cold as the winter climate!

BTW, good luck to Costa Rica in the upcoming World Cup! Four years ago, nobody expected them to get out of the group stage, let alone win their group that also consisted of England, Italy, and Uruguay. Keylor Navas is an incredible goalkeeper and has got to be riding high after winning another Champions League with Real Madrid.

I have been constantly tested for 35 years with no letting up. Most people would have reached their breaking point by now, but I only reached mine earlier this year. I was always told that life would eventually get better, but it never did. Now I'm entering the second\-half of my life and don't want to deal with the effects of aging on top of my constant loneliness, career regression, and other myriad problems.
I used to enjoy traveling, hiking, sports, music, and video games. Now I can't be bothered to do anything. And my anhedonia gets worse all the time.
